chunks.title: Purpose
chunks.heading: Purpose
chunks.text:
Currently, when an Adhoc FPPO is created through the New Job Order UI:
• Input and Output lines added in the Job Order transaction cannot be deleted during transaction creation/editing.
This creates operational inconvenience, and increases user effort during Job Order processing.
The requirement is to:
• Provide a delete option for Input and Output lines directly within the Job Order transaction screen.

chunks.title: Business Requirement
chunks.heading: Business Requirement
chunks.text:
The business requires improved traceability and transaction usability in the New Job Order UI for Adhoc FPPO transactions.
Currently:
• Incorrectly added Input/Output lines cannot be deleted immediately.
To improve operational efficiency and inventory tracking:
• Users should be able to delete wrongly added Input or Output lines before saving the transaction.
The enhancement must ensure:
• Reduced transaction correction effort.
• Improved user experience during Job Order creation and editing.

chunks.title: Input/Output Line Deletion Option
chunks.heading: Solution › … › Input/Output Line Deletion Option
chunks.text:
• The Job Order transaction screen will be enhanced with a Delete option for:
• Input lines
• Output lines
• Users will be able to:
• Remove incorrectly added lines before saving the transaction.
• A Delete icon/button will be available against each row.
